groups.root_cause: On Darwin, process ownership is decided by matching working directory and start time, so unrelated orphaned processes in the same cwd get claimed and killed.
The gate-timeout rerun path in the engine calls cleanup without the retry and recovery handling used on other paths, so a temporary cleanup failure aborts the whole run.
Darwin descendant discovery depends on an inherited environment marker, so a descendant that replaces its environment is no longer found and keeps running after cleanup reports success.
